clinician.final_diagnosis: B-ALL associated with a t(1;4) chromosomal abnormality
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 4-year-old girl presented with pharyngitis, asthenia, paleness, and fever. Initial CBC revealed anemia (Hb 6.00 g/dL), thrombocytopenia (PLT 41,000 cells/mm3), and neutropenia (Neu 570.103 cells/mm3). Bone marrow aspirate showed a rich marrow with 97% blast cells. Immunophenotyping indicated aberrant CD13 expression. Karyotyping identified a clone with a translocation t(1;4)(p21;p15) in 10/20 mitoses. Complementary FISH analysis showed the absence of rearrangement and/or deletion of the MLL gene.

key_supporting_evidence.claim: Patient presented with pharyngitis, asthenia, paleness, and fever.
Initial CBC showed anemia (Hb 6.00 g/dL), thrombocytopenia (PLT 41,000 cells/mm3), and neutropenia (Neu 570.103 cells/mm3).
Bone marrow aspirate revealed 97% blast cells.
Immunophenotyping showed aberrant expression of CD13.
Karyotype identified a translocation t(1;4)(p21;p15) in 10/20 mitoses.

ruled_out_or_less_likely_alternatives.basis: FISH showed absence of rearrangement and/or deletion of the MLL gene in all observed cells (200 mitoses) (E007).

remaining_uncertainties: Detailed immunophenotyping results confirming B-cell lineage (e.g., CD19, CD20, CD22, cCD79a) were not explicitly reported.
Specific FISH results for t(1;4) translocation were not explicitly detailed beyond the karyotype finding, although 'complementary FISH was performed'.
Clinical course, treatment, and outcome are not documented.
